#=============================

# 1. Fluad, Vaccine

## Compare DGE between organisms

```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
fluad_human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired")

fluad_mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"),
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 


#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human =
  bind_rows(
    human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    fluad_human_degs,
    fluad_mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary = degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary

```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg <- degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test,
    alpha = paired
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +
  
  # Continuous x-axis for numeric timepoints
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary$timepoint)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05), Fluad vaccine",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~organism, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75")
  )

# Render plot
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg

degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_mouse_human_dge_ttest_limma_summary.png"),
         width = 5,
         height = 5)
```

## Plot demographics

```{r}
#Import datasets
GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol = read_rds(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs_not_normalized.rds"))
GSE124689_metadata_clean = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_metadata_clean.rds"))
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_annotations = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_annotations_not_normalized_log2.rds"))
GSE120661_samples_pbmc = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_samples_pbmc.rds"))

#Bind mouse metadata to human data
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad") %>% 
  select(sample_id = geo_sample, 
         participant_id = subject_id, 
         vaccine = treatment,
         sex,
         strain,
         sample_type = tissue,
         timepoint,
         condition) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         type = "Inactivated",
         adjuvant = "MF59",
         age = 7, #6–8 weeks
         timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(.) / 24,
         timepoint = if_else(timepoint < 1 & timepoint != 0,
                             as.character(round(timepoint, 1)),
                             as.character(as.integer(round(timepoint, 0)))),
         race = strain, 
         array = "Agilent-028005 SurePrint G3 Mouse GE 8x60K Microarray") %>% 
  
  #Bind human data
  bind_rows(GSE124689_metadata_clean %>% 
               select(sample_id,
                      participant_id,
                      condition, timepoint,
                      sex, age, race, vaccine, 
                      sample_type, array, 
                      type, adjuvant) %>% 
              mutate(organism = "Human",
                     vaccine = "Fluad",
                     timepoint = as.character(timepoint)))

human_mouse_fluad_metadata

human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
```

## Number of DEGs

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# Get best and worst predicted genes ----
## Which genes have the least zscore?

#Import datasets
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_pairwise2human.rds")) %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol)
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx")) %>% 
  separate_rows(genes)


#Get total genes by each condition
degs_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_adj_mouse <= 0.05)
degs_human = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_adj_human <= 0.05)
degs_fit = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_adj_fit <= 0.05)
degs_mouse_summarize = degs_mouse %>% 
    group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            condition = "Mouse") %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_human %>%
              group_by(timepoint) %>%
              summarise(n_genes = n(),
                        condition = "Human")) %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_fit %>%
              group_by(timepoint) %>%
              summarise(n_genes = n(),
                        condition = "FIT"))

#Print
degs_mouse_summarize
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Get overlap -----
#Get symbols
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_fit_genes = degs_fit %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join, Mouse and Human, Human and FIT ------

#Mouse
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse AND Human",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human = degs_human_and_mouse_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#FIT
degs_human_and_fit_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_fit_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "FIT AND Human",
         comparison = "FIT vs Human",
         organism = "FIT",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_fit_genes_human = degs_human_and_fit_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#Anti join, Human vs Mouse, Human vs FIT -------
#Human
#Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse", 
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Human",
         group = "Not common")
#Human vs FIT
degs_human_Not_fit_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_fit_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT FIT",
         organism = "Human",
         comparison = "FIT vs Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Models
#Mouse vs Human
degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         group = "Not common")

#FIT vs Human
degs_human_Not_fit_genes = degs_fit_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "FIT NOT Human",
         organism = "FIT",
         comparison = "FIT vs Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Merge data ------
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human,
            degs_human_and_fit_genes,
            degs_human_and_fit_genes_human,
            degs_human_Not_mouse_genes,
             degs_human_Not_fit_genes,
            degs_mouse_Not_human_genes, 
            degs_human_Not_fit_genes)

#Classify by same and exclusive DEGs -----
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(condition, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            organism,
            comparison,
            group) %>% 
  distinct()

#Print
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary
```

## Get best and worst predicted genes

Which genes have the least zscore?

### Get by zscore

Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile

#### Mouse

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile -----
#By zscores ------
#Mouse
zscore_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_mouse, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2m) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2m, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs Mouse") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2m,
         mean_model = mean_mouse,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_mouse) %>% 
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(
    quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Pivot and sum only DEGs
zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, model, deg) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

####FIT

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#FIT
zscore_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_fit, pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2fit) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2fit, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_fit,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs FIT") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2fit,
         mean_model = mean_fit,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_fit) %>%
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Bind tables
zscore_genes = bind_rows(zscore_genes_fit, zscore_genes_mouse)

#Print
zscore_genes
```

Summarize genes by quantile

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Summarize genes by quantile ------
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
         pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  mutate(
    quartiles_grouped = case_when(
      quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
      quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  drop_na(quartiles_grouped) %>% 
  group_by(comparison, timepoint, quartiles_grouped) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparison == "Human vs FIT" ~ paste("FIT", quartiles_grouped),
                               comparison == "Human vs Mouse" ~ paste("Mouse", quartiles_grouped),
                               T~comparison)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Print
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data
```

### Scatterplot of correlation

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Scatterplot of correlation --------
#Get all genes by quantile
quantiles <- zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    q10  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Cumulative quantiles
diff_correlation_plot_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(quantiles, by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(
    Q10  = abs(zscore) <= q10,
    Q25  = abs(zscore) <= q25,
    Q50  = abs(zscore) <= q50,
    Q75  = abs(zscore) <= q75,
    Q100 = abs(zscore) <= q100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q10, Q25, Q50, Q75, Q100),
    names_to = "quantile_label_grouped",
    values_to = "in_quantile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quantile_label_grouped = fct_relevel(quantile_label_grouped, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)

#Print
diff_correlation_plot_data

#Diagnostics
diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj, comparison) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(comparison, model, timepoint, deg) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

### Enrichment analysis of genes in best and worst quartiles

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
# Enrichment analysis -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
##### Plot ORA Hallmark ------
#Import
ora_all_diff_hallmark = readRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))
#Cluster rows
row_clustered = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_p_adjust) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_p_adjust") %>%

    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()

#Plot
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "Q\\d{2,3}"),
        condition = paste(quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", 
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),

          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, MSigDB Hallmarks") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + fct_rev(comparison), scales = "free", space = "free")
```

## Top best and worst

```{r}
#Import data
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_pairwise2human.rds")) 
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
# Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse -----
pairwise_human_fit_genes_long =  pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_human, mean_mouse, mean_fit),
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(metric, "h2") ~ "FIT",
                              T~organism))  %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(organism == "mean_fit" ~ "FIT",
                              organism == "mean_human" ~ "Human",
                              organism == "mean_mouse" ~ "Mouse",
                              T ~ organism))

#Comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
    select(timepoint, symbol, human_2_mouse:effect_size_h2m) 

#Pivot table and join the comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide = pairwise_human_fit_genes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "metric",
              values_from = "value", 
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  select(!c(pval:effect_size_h2m)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons,
                by = join_by("timepoint", "symbol")) 


#Get top genes in each model
top_genes_human = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  relocate(ci_width,  .after = organism) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(ci_width) 
  
 top_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2m_adj), human_2_mouse)
 
 top_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2fit_adj), human_2_fit)
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
worst_mouse_fit_plot = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  arrange(symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  inner_join(worst_mouse_fit %>% 
              select(symbol, timepoint) %>%
               group_by(timepoint) %>% 
              mutate(day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
              distinct() %>% 
              slice_head(n = 5),
            by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = l2fc,
      color = organism,
      fill = organism) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray75", alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = organism), position = position_dodge2(1)) +
  # facet_wrap(~day~human_symbol, nrow = 3, scales = "free") +
  facet_grid(~day~symbol, scales = "free") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high),
                position =  position_dodge(1)
                ) +
      geom_point( position = position_dodge(1),
             color = "black",
             pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3, 7),minor_breaks = F) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    "Mouse" = "#546E7AFF",
    "Human" = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    "Mouse" = "#546E7AFF",
    "Human" = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", angle = 0),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Organism",
       x = "",
       y = "LogFold-Change",
       title = "Genes that were most different in Mouse prediction from FIT and human. Difference in Z-score")
```

#### Get ranks

```{r}
#Get ranks -----
#Mouse
ranks_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2m, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2m)
#FIT
ranks_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2fit, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2fit)

#Fit vs Mouse
ranks_fit_vs_mouse = ranks_fit %>% 
  select(symbol, fit = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_mouse %>% 
               select(symbol, mouse = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top FIT vs Mouse")

#Mouse vs FIT
ranks_mouse_vs_fit = ranks_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, mouse = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_fit %>% 
               select(symbol, fit = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top Mouse vs FIT")


#Get genes that are in the 10th percentile in one model, but are in the 90th percentile in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%
  filter(fit < 10, mouse > 90) %>%
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(mouse < 10, fit > 90)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit, zscore_h2fit,
         mouse, zscore_h2mouse)

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "percentile"
  )


#Get genes with least zscores in one model, but have the highest zscore in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%

  # FILTER BY N
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2fit), desc(abs(zscore_h2mouse))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2mouse), desc(abs(zscore_h2fit))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit = zscore_h2fit,
         mouse = zscore_h2mouse)
#Pivot longer
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "zscore"
  )

#Print
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore
```

## Correlation

### Correlation: Genes, means

```{r}
#Import
human_mouse_log2fc_samples =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_log2fc_samples.rds"))

human_mouse_fluad_metadata =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

#Pivot wider
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean, p_adj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = c(mean_log2fc, p_adj),
              names_sep = "_") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  #Drop genes that are absent in one of the organisms 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint))

# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "all") %>% 
  
  #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
    human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% btm_annotation_genes %>%                                                     filter(module_category == "immune") %>%                                                     pull(symbol)),
                             "immune",
                             "non_immune")) %>% 
    #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05 
         # & sign(mean_log2fc_human) == sign(mean_log2fc_mouse))
  ))
  
   

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the correlation
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y,  method = "spearman"),
  otherwise = NULL
)
cor_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>%
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(degs_immune_nonimmune_summary, by = join_by("timepoint", "gene_type")) %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_value   = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)      ~ "ns",
      p_value <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value)

  cor_data
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
genes_samples_long = human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
samples_annotation = genes_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
genes_samples_wide_all = genes_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_genes_samples_wide_all = genes_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_r = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Convert n matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_ngenes = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$n %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "n_genes")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_genes_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    n_genes,
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high, n_genes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

#Unite
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary


#Plot
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary_plot = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = as.numeric(timepoint),
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
      color = comparison,
      fill = comparison) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(pch = 21, fill = "white", size = 2, stroke = 1.5) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3, 7), expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-0.2, 1)
                     ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human vs. Mouse" = "#4361ee",
                                "Mouse vs. Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Human vs. Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse vs. Human" = "#4361ee",
                                "Mouse vs. Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Human vs. Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  labs(title = paste0("Correlation between organisms\n", gene_set_name),
       x = "",
       y = "Correlation",
       color = "Comparison") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

```{r}
dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>%
```

##### ssGSEA

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_log2fc_samples.rds")) 

#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "BTMs") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")

  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results.rds")))

beep()
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, group, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse,  
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint_num),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>%

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Import Hallmarks -------

#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_hallmarks_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_df, by = "symbol")

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_mean_process = dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint))
```

##### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = msigdbr_df %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, log2fold_change)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_hallmarks_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "MSigDB Hallmarks")


gsea_hallmarks_results = gsea_hallmarks_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process, by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
```

##### ssGSEA

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_log2fc_samples.rds")) 
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "Hallmarks") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results.rds")))

beep()
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
#Convert to wide
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(-symbol) %>% distinct(), by = "process")

#Plot
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation_plot = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint_num),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))  %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_l2fc_Human,
      labels = symbol) +
    #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  facet_grid(~group~timepoint, scales = "free") +
  #Plot all points
  geom_point(aes(fill = process,
                 color = process),
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.2,
             pch = 21) +
  #Plot only significant in both
  geom_point(aes(fill = process),
             data = . %>% filter(adj_p_val_Human <= 0.05 & adj_p_val_Mouse <= 0.05), 
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 1,
             pch = 21) +

  # scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +

  labs(fill = "Immune group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)",
       title = "Genes by BTM",
       subtitle = "Genes with adjusted p-value <= 0.05 in both organisms.") +
  # ylim(-2, 2) +
  # xlim(-2, 2) +
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = symbol),
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  data = . %>% filter(adj_p_val_Human <= 0.05 & adj_p_val_Mouse <=0.05) %>%
                    distinct(),
                  size = 2,
                  segment.size = 0.2,
                  lineheight = 0.8,
                  max.overlaps = 10) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.direction = "vertical", 
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
          ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

         width = 10,
```

Import

```{r}
#Import results -------
gsea_results = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds"))
dge_long_genes = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Influenza", vaccine = "Fluad",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
   rename(mean_l2fc = mean,
         ci_lower = lower,
         ci_upper = upper)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched = dge_hallmarks_process_genes 
gsea_results_matched = gsea_results 


#Mouse vs Human
#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_results_matched %>% 
  select(organism, timepoint, process,  set_size, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, qvalue) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process, set_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, qvalue, set_size),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup()


dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(mean_l2fc_Human) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))



#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>%  
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y,  method = "spearman"),
  otherwise = NULL
)
cor_labels_sig <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
    inner_join(dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% select(process, timepoint, p_adjust_Mouse, p_adjust_Human) %>% 
               filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25),
               # filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_Human <= 0.25),
             by = join_by("process", "timepoint")) %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(safe_cor_test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "filtered",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
 mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 




# NES vs NES
cor_labels_nes <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(process, timepoint,  Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(safe_cor_test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
     ),
  
  
  
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

#Significant in both
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y,  method = "spearman"),
  otherwise = NULL
)

cor_labels_nes_sig <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
               # filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_Human <= 0.25),
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(test_result, ~ if(!is.null(.x)) .x$estimate else NA_real_),
    p_value   = map_dbl(test_result, ~ if(!is.null(.x)) .x$p.value  else NA_real_),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)    ~ "ns",
      p_value <= 0.01   ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05   ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10   ~ "*",
      TRUE              ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    filter = "filtered",
    timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))
  )
```

### Sample-wise analysis

Annotate genes log2fc table with BTMs

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# input
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_log2fc_samples.rds"))

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"
#Annotate genes by BTM 
results_genes_btm_df = samples_log2fc %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(symbol = human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc, organism) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol")

#Save
results_genes_btm_df %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc_long.rds")))

#Pivot wider
dge_btm_mean_process = results_genes_btm_df %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process

#Save
```

##### Means (Immune)

###### Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

Scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Annotate genes by BTM and reshape to wide (participants as columns)
dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(
    # participant_id = str_remove(participant_id, "PAXGENEENR.CEL") %>% str_remove("rep"),
    participant_id = paste0(organism, "_", participant_id)
  ) 

# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == 1) %>%
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_value = cor(mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse, method = "spearman",
                    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2))
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----
timepoint_selected = 1
samples_btm_scatterplot = plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_log2fc_mouse, y = mean_log2fc_human)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), alpha = 0.2, size = 2, color = "black", pch = 21) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 1, se = F, size = 1) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = cor_labels %>% 
      filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected),
    aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(~participant_id_human~participant_id_mouse, scales = "free") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Mouse Log2FC",
    y = "Human Log2FC",
    title = paste0(filename, ", Mouse vs. Human, samples")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

###### Summarize inter-individual correlation

###### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

#Print
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
```

```{r}
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint))

hallmarks_samples_annotation = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_hallmarks_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants) %>%
  inner_join(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  nes_human, nes_mouse) %>% 
  filter(timepoint_human == timepoint_mouse)

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_human) %>% 
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(
      x = nes_human,
      y = nes_mouse,
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "estimate"),
    p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "p.value"),
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-test)
cor_labels
```

## Get overlap

Input

```{r}
# Import datasets
dge_long_genes = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(organism == "Mouse", (as.numeric(timepoint)/24) %>% round(0) %>% as.character(), timepoint) ,
         condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  distinct()
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = human_symbol) 

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

annotation_metadata$condition %>% unique()
#Inputs
filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

###Plot correlation

```{r}
#Import
human_mouse_log2fc_samples =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_exprs_samples_log2fc.rds"))

human_mouse_engerix_metadata =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

all_degs_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_degs_mouse.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC") %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = timepoint /24,
         timepoint = timepoint %>% as.character())



#Pivot wider
human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human %>% 
  bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  #Add padj columns
  inner_join(all_degs_human %>%
               bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
               select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, adj_p_val) %>%
               pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
                           values_from = "adj_p_val") %>%
               rename(padj_human = Human, padj_mouse = Mouse)) %>% 
  #Drop genes that are absent in one of the organisms 
  drop_na()

# Calculate the correlation
cor_data <- human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(padj_human <= 0.05 | padj_human <= 0.05) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_value = cor(Mouse, Human, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    label_pos_x = max(Mouse, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_pos_y = max(Human, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2)))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
genes_samples_long = human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
samples_annotation = genes_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
genes_samples_wide_all = genes_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_genes_samples_wide_all = genes_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_r = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_genes_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

#Unite
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary


#Plot
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary_plot = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = as.numeric(timepoint),
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
      color = comparison,
      fill = comparison) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(pch = 21, fill = "white", size = 2, stroke = 1.5) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3, 7), expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-0.2, 1)
                     ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human vs. Mouse" = "#4361ee",
                                "Mouse vs. Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Human vs. Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse vs. Human" = "#4361ee",
                                "Mouse vs. Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Human vs. Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  labs(title = paste0("Correlation between organisms\n", gene_set_name),
       x = "",
       y = "Correlation",
       color = "Comparison") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

#### Correlation: Genes, means

```{r}
#Import
human_mouse_log2fc_samples =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_exprs_samples_log2fc.rds"))

human_mouse_metadata =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"
#Pivot wider
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = c(mean_log2fc, p_adj),
              names_sep = "_") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  #Drop genes that are absent in one of the organisms 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = paste0("Day", timepoint))

# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "all") %>% 
  
  #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
    human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% btm_annotation_genes %>%                                                     filter(module_category == "immune") %>%                                                     pull(symbol)),
                             "immune",
                             "non_immune")) %>% 
    #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05 
         # & sign(mean_log2fc_human) == sign(mean_log2fc_mouse))
  ))
  
   

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the correlation
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y,  method = "spearman"),
  otherwise = NULL
)
cor_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>%
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(degs_immune_nonimmune_summary, by = join_by("timepoint", "gene_type")) %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_value   = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)      ~ "ns",
      p_value <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value)

cor_data
```

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Hepatitis B", vaccine = "EngerixB",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint),
         timepoint = if_else(organism == "Mouse", as.numeric(timepoint)/24, timepoint))

#Import BTMs annotation table

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%

            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
```

##### ssGSEA

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_exprs_samples_log2fc.rds")) 
dge_btm_mean_process = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds"))

#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "BTMs") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results.rds")))

#Summarize ssGSEA

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_nes   = mean(nes),
    median_nes = median(nes),
    sd_nes     = sd(nes),
    var_nes    = var(nes),
    n_subjects = n(),
    # p-value do summary via one-sample t-test
    pvalue     = t.test(nes, mu = 0)$p.value,
    organism   = dplyr::first(organism),
    group      = dplyr::first(group),
    p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process, by = join_by("organism","timepoint", "process", "group")) %>% 
  rename(nes = mean_nes, median = median_nes)

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results_summary.rds")))

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary

beep()
```
