```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=8}
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 color = group),
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.2,
             pch = 21) +
  #Plot only significant in both
  geom_point(aes(fill = group),
             data = . %>% filter(adj_p_val_Human <= 0.05 & adj_p_val_Mouse <= 0.05), 
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 1,
             pch = 21) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  guides(color = F) +
  labs(fill = "Immune group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)",
       title = "Genes by BTM",
       subtitle = "Genes with adjusted p-value <= 0.05 in both organisms.") +
  # ylim(-2, 2) +
  # xlim(-2, 2) +
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = symbol), 
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  data = . %>% filter(adj_p_val_Human <= 0.05 & adj_p_val_Mouse <=0.05) %>% 
                    distinct(), 
                  size = 2, 
                  segment.size = 0.2,  
                  lineheight = 0.8, 
                  max.overlaps = 10) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
          )
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
dge_btm_process_wide = dge_btm_process  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(process, mean_log2fc, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>%

  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>%

  group_by(timepoint, process, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(nes, p_adjust, mean_log2fc),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_process_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>%  
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

#### MSigDB Hallmarks

##### Mean Log2FC

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Hepatitis B", vaccine = "EngerixB",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint),
         timepoint = if_else(organism == "Mouse", as.numeric(timepoint)/24, timepoint))

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Import Hallmarks -------

#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_hallmarks_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped, by = "symbol")

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_mean_process = dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

#Print
dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
```

##### GSEA

```{r}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = msigdbr_df %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, log2fold_change)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_hallmarks_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "MSigDB Hallmarks")


gsea_hallmarks_results = gsea_hallmarks_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process, by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
```

##### ssGSEA

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_exprs_samples_log2fc.rds")) 
#Genes L2FC table annotated with BTMs
dge_hallmarks_mean_process = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")) 
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "Hallmarks") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results.rds")))


#Summarize ssGSEA

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_nes   = mean(nes),
    median_nes = median(nes),
    sd_nes     = sd(nes),
    var_nes    = var(nes),
    n_subjects = n(),
    # p-value do summary via one-sample t-test
    pvalue     = t.test(nes, mu = 0)$p.value,
    organism   = dplyr::first(organism),
    group      = dplyr::first(group),
    p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process, by = join_by("organism","timepoint", "process")) %>% 
  rename(nes = mean_nes, median = median_nes)

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results_summary.rds")))

beep()
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_process_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>%  
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

cor_labels_sig <- dge_hallmarks_process_wide %>%
    inner_join(dge_hallmarks_ssgsea_mean_wide %>% select(process, timepoint, p_adjust_Mouse, p_adjust_Human) %>% 
               filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25),
             by = join_by("process", "timepoint")) %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(safe_cor_test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "filtered",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

  ungroup() %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>%

             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()
```

###### Summarize inter-individual correlation

###### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
```

```{r}
hallmarks_samples_long = dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
hallmarks_samples_annotation = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_hallmarks_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>%

  group_by(organism) %>%

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  filter(organism == "Human",

  inner_join(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse",

  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  nes_human, nes_mouse) %>% 
  filter(timepoint_human == timepoint_mouse)

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----

      x = nes_human,
      y = nes_mouse,
      method = "spearman"

    .groups = "drop"

  mutate(

    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),

    )
```

# 3. S. aureus

## Get overlap

Input

```{r}
# Import datasets
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = human_symbol)

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint))

annotation_metadata$condition %>% unique()
#Inputs
filename = "saureus_infection"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

## Correlation analysis

#### Correlation: Genes, means

```{r}
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))  
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"
#Pivot wider to compare human to different mouse times
#Human
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = 
  
  #Human
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = "24h") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, 
         timepoint_human = timepoint, 
         mean_log2fc_human = mean_l2fc,
         p_value_human = p_value,
         p_adj_human = adj_p_val) %>% 
  inner_join(
  #Mouse
  all_degs_human_mouse%>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint, 
         mean_log2fc_mouse = mean_l2fc,
         p_value_mouse = p_value,
         p_adj_mouse = adj_p_val) %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_reorder(timepoint_mouse, c(timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric()))),
  by = "human_symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint_mouse,
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint_mouse, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 


# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "all") %>% 
  
  #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
    human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
                                                   filter(module_category == "immune") %>% 
                                                   pull(symbol)),
                             "immune",
                             "non_immune")) %>% 
    #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05 
         # & sign(mean_log2fc_human) == sign(mean_log2fc_mouse))
  ))
  
   

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the correlation
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y,  method = "spearman"),
  otherwise = NULL
)
cor_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>%
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(degs_immune_nonimmune_summary, by = join_by("timepoint", "gene_type")) %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_value   = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)      ~ "ns",
      p_value <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value)

cor_data
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
  inner_join(cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_genes_samples_wide_all_ngenes, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    n_genes = n_genes,
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high, n_genes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison)  %>% 
  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 
  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())
```

#### 5 to 5 bootstrap

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# This script performs cross-species correlation (Human vs. Mouse)
# using the bootstrap method (1000 iterations), sampling 5 participants
# from each organism in each iteration.

# --- 1. BOOTSTRAP CONFIGURATION ---
timepoints_mouse = unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")  %>% pull(timepoint)) %>% as.numeric()
timepoints_human = unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human")  %>% pull(timepoint)) %>% as.numeric()

# --- 2. DATA PREPARATION AND FILTERING ---
# Filters raw log2fc data only for the relevant timepoints
data_filtered <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoints_mouse, timepoints_human)) 

mouse_data <- data_filtered %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")
human_data <- data_filtered %>% filter(organism == "Human")

# --- 3. FUNCTION FOR A SINGLE BOOTSTRAP ITERATION ---

# This function performs a single bootstrap iteration for a timepoint.
# 1. Samples 5 Human and 5 Mouse IDs (with replacement).
# 2. Filters data for sampled IDs and common symbols (genes).
# 3. Calculates the cross-correlation matrix (5x5)

get_bootstrap_cors <- function(timepoint_mouse, timepoint_human, all_human_data, all_mouse_data, n_sample) {

  h_tp_data <- all_human_data %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_human)
  m_tp_data <- all_mouse_data %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_mouse)

  common_symbols <- intersect(h_tp_data$human_symbol, m_tp_data$human_symbol)

  if (length(unique(h_tp_data$participant_id)) < n_sample ||
      length(unique(m_tp_data$participant_id)) < n_sample ||
      length(common_symbols) == 0) {

    message(paste("No sufficient data for mouse timepoint:", timepoint_mouse))

    return(tibble(
      timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
      timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse,
      correlation = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  sampled_human <- sample(unique(h_tp_data$participant_id), n_sample, replace = TRUE)
  sampled_mouse <- sample(unique(m_tp_data$participant_id), n_sample, replace = TRUE)

  h_matrix <- h_tp_data %>%
    filter(participant_id %in% sampled_human, human_symbol %in% common_symbols) %>%
    distinct(human_symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  m_matrix <- m_tp_data %>%
    filter(participant_id %in% sampled_mouse, human_symbol %in% common_symbols) %>%
    distinct(human_symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  colnames(h_matrix) <- paste0("Human_", 1:ncol(h_matrix))
  colnames(m_matrix) <- paste0("Mouse_", 1:ncol(m_matrix))

  cross_cors <- cor(h_matrix, m_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

  tibble(
    timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
    timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse,
    correlation = as.vector(cross_cors)
  )
}


# --- 4. BOOTSTRAP EXECUTION ---
N_BOOTSTRAPS = 10    # Number of bootstrap iterations
SAMPLE_SIZE = 5       # 5 humans vs 5 mice in each iteration

# Creates a dataframe of bootstrap IDs and applies the function for all timepoints
bootstrapped_human_mouse_cors <- expand_grid(
  bootstrap_id = 1:N_BOOTSTRAPS,
  human_tp = timepoints_human,
  mouse_tp = timepoints_mouse
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    cors = list(
      get_bootstrap_cors(mouse_tp, 24, human_data, mouse_data, SAMPLE_SIZE)
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(cors)

# --- 5. BOOTSTRAP RESULTS SUMMARIZATION ---

# Calculates descriptive statistics on the distribution of correlations
# obtained by the 1000 bootstrap iterations (N_total = 1000 * 25 = 25000 observations)
correlation_bootstrap_summary <- bootstrapped_human_mouse_cors %>%
 group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    comparison = "Bootstrap Mouse vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    sd = sd(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    se = sd,
    ci_low = quantile(correlation, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(4),
    ci_high = quantile(correlation, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(4),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_human = as.character(timepoint_human),
         timepoint_mouse = as.character(timepoint_mouse),
         time_unit = "h")

correlation_bootstrap_summary
```

#### ssGSEA

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Get annotated processes
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "BTMs") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results.rds")))

beep()
```

```{r}
      values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    select(
      symbol,
      process, 
      timepoint,
      Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      Human = mean_l2fc_Human,
      adj_p_val_Mouse,
      adj_p_val_Human,
      group
    ) %>% 
  drop_na(Human, Mouse) 

safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_btm_process_genes_correlation = dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%
  # substituir NULL por lista com NA
  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

filter_1 = dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label, timepoint_num, -p_value)

filter_1_wide = filter_1 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "p_label_mouse", 
              values_from = c("cor_value", "n_genes", "r_squared")) %>% 
  mutate(diff_cor = cor_value_DEG - cor_value_all,
         diff_n_genes = n_genes_DEG - n_genes_all,
         diff_r_squared = r_squared_DEG - r_squared_all)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(timepoint)  %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
gsea_btm_results_core = gsea_results_matched %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/")

gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, process, status)


shared_perc = gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process, status) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100,
         percent = percent %>% round(0)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Which are the processes that share most of the core genes?
shared_perc %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared") %>% 
  arrange(-n, -percent)

#What is the mean percentage?
mean_percentage_shared = shared_perc %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, status) %>% 
  summarise(mean_perc = mean(percent)) %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared")

mean_percentage_shared
```

Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?

```{r}
#Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?
df_test =
  dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(str_detect(process, "S2"),
         timepoint == "12") %>% 
  
  # Join com os genes core
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "S2"),
             timepoint == "12"),
    by = join_by("process", "timepoint", symbol == gene)
  ) %>% 
  
  # join com shared %
  inner_join(
    shared_perc %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "S2"),
             timepoint == "12",
             status == "Shared") %>%
      rename(percent = percent,
             status_percent = status),
    by = join_by("process", "timepoint")
  ) %>%
  
  # join com NES
  inner_join(
    dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "S2"),
             timepoint == "12") %>% 
      select(process, timepoint, nes_Mouse, nes_Human),
    by = join_by("process", "timepoint")
  ) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    nes_Mouse = round(nes_Mouse, 2),
    nes_Human = round(nes_Human, 2),
    
    # criar label completo para facet
    facet_label = paste0(
      process, " — Shared = ", percent, "%, ",
      "NES Mouse = ", nes_Mouse, ", NES Human = ", nes_Human
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not core", status)) %>% 
  inner_join(dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
               mutate(timepoint_num = as.character(timepoint_num)) %>% 
               select(timepoint = timepoint_num, process, cor_value, r_squared, p_label, cor_label),
             by = join_by("process", "timepoint"))
```

### MSigDB Hallmarks

#### Mean Log2FC

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Saureus")

filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Import Hallmarks -------

msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_hallmarks_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped, by = "symbol")

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_mean_process = dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

#Print
dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
```

#### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, log2fold_change)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_hallmarks_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "MSigDB Hallmarks")


gsea_hallmarks_results = gsea_hallmarks_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  inner_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process, by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  gsea_hallmarks_results
#Save
gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
```

#### ssGSEA

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "saureus_infection"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "Hallmarks") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results.rds")))

beep()
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
#Import ========================
gsea_hallmarks_results = readRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_mean_process = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_process_genes = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

#If timepoints match between ref and target, use this
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched = dge_hallmarks_process_genes

#Duplicate reference, if timepoints do not match =================

human_data_reference <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% filter(organism == "Human")
new_timepoints <- c(dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% filter(organism != "Human") %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character())
duplicated_human_data <- map_dfr(new_timepoints, ~ {
  df_copy <- human_data_reference
  df_copy <- df_copy %>%
    mutate(timepoint = .x)

  return(df_copy)
})

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched = dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data) 

#For GSEA results
human_data_reference <- gsea_hallmarks_results %>% filter(organism == "Human")
new_timepoints <- c(gsea_hallmarks_results %>% filter(organism != "Human") %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character())
duplicated_human_data <- map_dfr(new_timepoints, ~ {
  df_copy <- human_data_reference
  df_copy <- df_copy %>%
    mutate(timepoint = .x)

  return(df_copy)
})

gsea_hallmarks_results_matched = gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data) 

# ================================

#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_hallmarks_results_matched %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(condition, "Human") ~ "Human",
                              T~condition)) %>% 
  select(organism, timepoint, process, set_size, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, qvalue) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process,  set_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, qvalue, set_size),
    names_sep = "_")

#Arrange process by log2fc
process_order_log2fc = dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, organism, mean_log2fc) %>%
  filter(timepoint == 24,
         organism == "Human") %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(-mean_log2fc) %>%
  pull(process) %>% 
  unique() 

labels_process <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(process, p_adjust_Human, p_adjust_Mouse) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(p_adjust_Human <= 0.10 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.10, 
                         "bold", "plain"),
         label_color = ifelse(p_adjust_Human <= 0.10 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.10, 
                         "#4DBBD5FF", "gray50"))  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(process = fct_relevel(process, process_order_log2fc)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(p_adjust_Human))
  

#Plot
dge_hallmarks_process_distribution = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group), by = "process") %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(timepoint),
      timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = process,
      x = mean_l2fc,
      color = organism) +
  facet_grid(~timepoint~group, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_point(pch = "|", alpha = 1, 
             show.legend = F,
             size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
  aes(color = organism),
  fun.data = mean_se,
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.5,
  size = 1) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = organism), 
    fun = mean,             
    color = "black",
    geom = "point",             
    size = 2,    
    pch = 21,  
    alpha = 1,
    show.legend = T 
  ) +
  
  # xlim(-2, 2) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray", alpha = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, face = c(labels_process$label), 
                                   color = c(labels_process$label_color)),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
    labs(color = "Organism",
       y = "",
       x = "Log2FC",
       fill = "Organism",
       title = "Mouse vs Human, MSigDB genes, mean Log2FC") 

dge_hallmarks_process_distribution
```

Plot correlation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Mouse vs Human
#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_results_matched %>% 
  select(organism, timepoint, process,  set_size, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, qvalue) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process, set_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, qvalue, set_size),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup()


dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(mean_l2fc_Human)



#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>%  
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))

cor_labels_sig <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "filtered",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

##### Plot means

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=12}
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(), by = "process") %>%
  mutate(process = str_replace_all(process, "_", " ") %>% str_wrap(width = 15)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse)

#Plot correlation plot (means)
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot =  dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_log2fc_Human,
      labels = process) +
    #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~timepoint, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  #Plot all points
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 color = group),
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.2,
             pch = 21) +
  #Plot only significant in both
  geom_point(aes(fill = group),
             # data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25), 
             data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25), 
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 1,
             pch = 21) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  guides(color = F) +
  labs(fill = "Group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)",
       title = paste0("MSigDB Hallmarks, GSEA, Log2FC mean, ", filename),
       subtitle = "Processes that have padj <0.25 in both human and model have alpha = 1.") +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  xlim(-1, 2) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
          )

plot_significance_categories = dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
    sig_mouse = p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25,
    sig_human = p_adjust_Human <= 0.25,
    significance = case_when(
      sig_mouse & sig_human ~ "Human & Mouse",
      sig_mouse & !sig_human ~ "Mouse only",
      !sig_mouse & sig_human ~ "Human only",
      TRUE ~ "N.S."
    ),
    timepoint = fct_rev(timepoint),
    significance = fct_relevel(significance, "N.S.", "Mouse only", "Human only", "Human & Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::count(significance) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n,
    y = timepoint,
    fill = significance
  )) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human & Mouse" = "#4361ee",
    "Mouse only" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human only" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "N.S." = "gray90"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Significance of Biological Processes",
    subtitle = "Stacked counts — padj ≤ 0.25",
    x = "Processes",
    y = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0))



#Print
```

#### Means (BTM)

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"

  ungroup() %>% 
  select(symbol = human_symbol, participant_id = subject_id, geo_sample, timepoint, log2fc, organism) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol")

  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) %>%

  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process
```

##### Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

Scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Annotate genes by BTM and reshape to wide (participants as columns)
dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = str_remove(participant_id, "PAXGENEENR.CEL") %>% str_remove("rep"),
    participant_id = paste0(organism, "_", participant_id)
  ) 

# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == 12) %>%
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_value = cor(mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2))
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----
timepoint_selected = 2
samples_btm_scatterplot = plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_log2fc_mouse, y = mean_log2fc_human)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), alpha = 0.2, size = 2, color = "black", pch = 21) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 1, se = F, size = 1) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = cor_labels %>% 
      filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected),
    aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(~participant_id_human~participant_id_mouse, scales = "free") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  xlim(-3, 3) +
  ylim(-3, 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Mouse Log2FC",
    y = "Human Log2FC",
    title = paste0(filename, ", Mouse vs. Human, samples")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

samples_btm_scatterplot

samples_btm_scatterplot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_group_scatterplot.png")),
         width = 10,
         height = 10)
```

##### Summarize inter-individual correlation

##### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_condition1 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", "24", timepoint_condition1),
         timepoint_condition2 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", "24", timepoint_condition2),
         timepoint = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint))  %>% 
  distinct()

# Save output
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))


```

Plot scatterplot

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}

  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  nes_human, nes_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(
      x = nes_human,
      y = nes_mouse,
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "estimate"),
    p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "p.value"),
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-test)
cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----
timepoint_selected = 12
samples_hallmarks_scatterplot = plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = nes_mouse, y = nes_human)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), alpha = 1, size = 2, color = "black", pch = 21) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 1, se = F, size = 1) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +

    data = cor_labels %>% 
      filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected),
    aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Mouse NES",
    y = "Human NES",

  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, nes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "nes") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

   # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_condition1 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint_condition1),
         timepoint_condition2 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint_condition2),
         timepoint = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint))  %>% 
  distinct()

# Save output

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_ssgsea_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

# 4. E. coli

## Get overlap

Input

```{r}
# Import datasets
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = human_symbol)

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint))

annotation_metadata$condition %>% unique()
#Inputs
filename = "ecoli_infection"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

### Correlation analysis

#### Correlation: Genes, means

```{r}
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))  
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Pivot wider to compare human to different mouse times
#Human
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = 
  
  #Human
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         timepoint == "24") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, 
         timepoint_human = timepoint, 
         mean_log2fc_human = mean_l2fc,
         p_value_human = p_value,
         p_adj_human = adj_p_val) %>% 
  inner_join(
  #Mouse
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint, 
         mean_log2fc_mouse = mean_l2fc,
         p_value_mouse = p_value,
         p_adj_mouse = adj_p_val) %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_reorder(timepoint_mouse, c(timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric()))),
  by = "human_symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint_mouse,
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint_mouse, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "all") %>% 
  
  #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
    human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% btm_annotation_genes %>%                                                     filter(module_category == "immune") %>%                                                     pull(symbol)),
                             "immune",
                             "non_immune")) %>% 
    #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05 
         # & sign(mean_log2fc_human) == sign(mean_log2fc_mouse))
  ))
  
   

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the correlation
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y,  method = "spearman"),
  otherwise = NULL
)
cor_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>%
  group_by(timepoint, gene_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(degs_immune_nonimmune_summary, by = join_by("timepoint", "gene_type")) %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_value   = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)      ~ "ns",
      p_value <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value)

cor_data
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
genes_samples_long = human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
samples_annotation = genes_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
genes_samples_wide_all = genes_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_genes_samples_wide_all = genes_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_r = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Convert n matrix to long format
cor_genes_samples_wide_all_ngenes = cor_genes_samples_wide_all$n %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "n_genes")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_genes_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_genes_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_genes_samples_wide_all_ngenes, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    n_genes = n_genes,
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high, n_genes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison)  %>% 
  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 
  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary_plot = correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
      color = comparison,
      fill = comparison) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(pch = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5, size = 2) +

  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), limits = c(-0.2, 1)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human vs. Mouse" = "#4361ee",
                                "Mouse vs. Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Human vs. Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse vs. Human" = "#4361ee",
                                "Mouse vs. Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Human vs. Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  labs(title = paste0("Correlation between organisms,\n", gene_set_name),
       x = "",
       y = "Correlation",
       color = "Comparison") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(fill = "none")
```
