BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species Compare means and NES

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Ecoli")
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(immune_set == "BTM by Modules") %>%
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

##### ssGSEA

##### Corto

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  rename(participant_id = subject_id) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "BTMs") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results.rds")))

beep()

#Summarize ssGSEA

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_nes   = mean(nes),
    median_nes = median(nes),
    sd_nes     = sd(nes),
    var_nes    = var(nes),
    n_subjects = n(),
    # p-value do summary via one-sample t-test
    pvalue     = t.test(nes, mu = 0)$p.value,
    organism   = dplyr::first(organism),
    group      = dplyr::first(group),
    p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process, by = join_by("organism","timepoint", "process", "group")) %>% 
  rename(nes = mean_nes, median = median_nes)

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, group, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,

    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))


cor_labels_nes_sig <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, group, subgroup, Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=9}
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%

  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,

#Plot correlation plot (means)
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot =  dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_log2fc_Human,
      labels = process) +
    #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  
  facet_grid(~timepoint, scales = "free") +
  #Plot all points
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 color = group),
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.2,
             pch = 21) +
  #Plot only significant in both
  geom_point(aes(fill = group),
             # data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25), 
             data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25), 
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 1,
             pch = 21) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  guides(color = F) +
  labs(fill = "Group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)",
       title = paste0("BTM immune, GSEA, Log2FC mean, ", filename),
       subtitle = "Processes that have padj <0.25 in both human and model have alpha = 1.") +
  ylim(-2, 2) +
  xlim(-1, 2) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top",

          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
          )
```

```{r}
significance_counts <- dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig_mouse = p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25,
    sig_human = p_adjust_Human <= 0.25,
    significance = case_when(
      sig_mouse & sig_human ~ "Human AND Mouse",
      sig_mouse & !sig_human ~ "Mouse only",
      !sig_mouse & sig_human ~ "Human only",
      TRUE ~ "N.S."
    ),
    significance = fct_relevel(significance, "N.S.", "Mouse only", "Human only", "Human AND Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::count(significance)
    
    
plot_significance_categories 

significance_counts %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n , y = significance, fill = significance)) +
  xlim(0, max(significance_counts$n) + 20) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human AND Mouse" = "#4361ee",
    "Mouse only" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human only" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "N.S." = "gray90"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Significant Processes",
    subtitle = "Threshold: padj ≤ 0.25",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Number of Processes"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot_facetted = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_log2fc_Human,
      color = group) +
  facet_grid(~group~timepoint, scales = "free") +
  #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
    geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  
    #Plot all
    geom_point(aes(fill = group),
               color = "black",
               size = 2,
               alpha = 0.2,
               pch = 21) +
    #Plot only significant in both
    geom_point(aes(fill = group),
               data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25), 
               color = "black",
               size = 2,
               alpha = 1,
               pch = 21) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = process),
                    color = "black",
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25) %>%
                    mutate(diff = mean_log2fc_Human - mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>%
                    group_by(timepoint, group) %>% 
                    slice_min(n = 5, abs(diff)) %>% 
                    ungroup(), 
                  size = 2, 
                  segment.size = 0.2,  
                  lineheight = 0.8, 
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
    guides(color = F) +
    labs(fill = "Immune group",
         y = "Human (Log2FC)",
         x = "Model (Log2FC)") +
    #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0))
```

```{r}
#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
```

##### ssGSEA

Import data

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  rename(participant_id = subject_id) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "Hallmarks") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results.rds")))


#Summarize ssGSEA

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_nes   = mean(nes),
    median_nes = median(nes),
    sd_nes     = sd(nes),
    var_nes    = var(nes),
    n_subjects = n(),
    # p-value do summary via one-sample t-test
    pvalue     = t.test(nes, mu = 0)$p.value,
    organism   = dplyr::first(organism),
    group      = dplyr::first(group),
    p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process, by = join_by("organism","timepoint", "process")) %>% 
  rename(nes = mean_nes, median = median_nes)

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results_summary.rds")))

beep()
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
dge_hallmarks_ssgsea_mean_wide = ssgsea_results_matched %>% 
  select(organism, timepoint, process, group, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(nes, p_adjust, mean_log2fc),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))



#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>%  
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))

                                        y = Mouse,

  # Labels

    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),

  select(process, timepoint, group, Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "spearman")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 
```




### Sample-wise analysis

Annotate genes log2fc table with BTMs

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

#Example input
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))

#Annotate genes by BTM 
results_genes_btm_df = samples_log2fc %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(symbol = human_symbol, participant_id = subject_id, geo_sample, timepoint, log2fc, organism) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol")

#Save
results_genes_btm_df %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc_long.rds")))


#Pivot wider
dge_btm_mean_process = results_genes_btm_df %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process

#Save
dge_btm_mean_process %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc.rds")))

```

Import data from different organisms

```{r}
#Genes L2FC table annotated with BTMs
dge_btm_mean_process_samples = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_btm_samples_log2fc_long.rds")) 

#Import metadata
mouse_human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Calculate the mean log2fc by module
dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long = results_genes_btm_df %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(organism == "Human", "24", timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(group,
            subgroup, 
            mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()

#Pivot wider
dge_btm_mean_process_sample_wide = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", 
              values_from = "mean_log2fc")
  
```

#### Mean-log2FC by sample

##### Immune

###### Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

Scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Annotate genes by BTM and reshape to wide (participants as columns)
dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(
    # participant_id = str_remove(participant_id, "PAXGENEENR.CEL") %>% str_remove("rep"),
    participant_id = paste0(organism, "_", participant_id)
  ) 

# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == 24) %>%
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_value = cor(mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
```

###### summarise inter-individual correlation

###### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

# Save output
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

#### ssGSEA

##### Immune

Import data

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  rename(participant_id = subject_id) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "BTMs") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results.rds")))

beep()
```

###### Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == "24") %>%
  inner_join(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  nes_human, nes_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(
      x = nes_human,
      y = nes_mouse,
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "estimate"),
    p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "p.value"),
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-test)
cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----
timepoint_selected = 12
samples_hallmarks_scatterplot = plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = nes_mouse, y = nes_human)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), alpha = 1, size = 2, color = "black", pch = 21) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 1, se = F, size = 1) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = cor_labels %>% 
      filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected),
    aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(~participant_id_human~participant_id_mouse, scales = "free") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  # xlim(-1, 1) +
  # ylim(-1, 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Mouse NES",
    y = "Human NES",
    title = paste0(filename, ", Mouse vs. Human, samples")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

###### summarise inter-individual correlation

###### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, nes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "nes") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

# Save output

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_ssgsea_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

##### MSigDB Hallmarks

Import data

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  rename(participant_id = subject_id) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "Hallmarks") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_hallmarks_results.rds")))

beep()
```

######Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == "24") %>%
  inner_join(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  nes_human, nes_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(
      x = nes_human,
      y = nes_mouse,
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "estimate"),
    p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "p.value"),
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-test)
cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----
timepoint_selected = 12
samples_hallmarks_scatterplot = plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = nes_mouse, y = nes_human)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), alpha = 1, size = 2, color = "black", pch = 21) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 1, se = F, size = 1) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = cor_labels %>% 
      filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected),
    aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(~participant_id_human~participant_id_mouse, scales = "free") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  # xlim(-1, 1) +
  # ylim(-1, 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Mouse NES",
    y = "Human NES",
    title = paste0(filename, ", Mouse vs. Human, samples")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# 5. Merge analyses
## Stacked barplot of overlapped genes

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Import datasets
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val) %>% 
  bind_rows(
  #Duplcate Human
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         treatment == "Infection") %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val) %>% 
  inner_join(all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse",
                      treatment == "Infection") %>% 
               select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "pathogen")
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)))

#Get total genes by each condition
degs_mouse = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Mouse")
degs_human = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human")

degs_mouse_summarize = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n()) 

#Print
degs_mouse_summarize

#Get overlap -----
#Get symbols
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join, Mouse and Human ------

#Mouse
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse AND Human",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human = degs_human_and_mouse_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")


#Anti join, Human vs Mouse -------
#Human
#Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse", 
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Models
#Mouse vs Human
degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         group = "Not common")


#Merge data ------
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human,
            degs_human_Not_mouse_genes,
            degs_mouse_Not_human_genes 
            )

#Classify by same and exclusive DEGs -----
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, condition, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            organism,
            comparison,
            group) %>% 
  distinct()

#Print
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary
```

## Correlation

### Correlation: Genes, means

```{r}
#Import
#Log2FC from samples
log2fc_samples = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))

#Metadata from samples
all_human_mouse_metadata =
  readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#DEGs
all_degs_human_mouse = 
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint),
         timepoint = if_else(treatment != "Infection", paste0("Day ", timepoint), paste0(timepoint, "h")))

#Functional modules
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))


all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(timepoint, treatment, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()
```


```{r}
#Pivot wider
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  bind_rows(
  #Duplcate Human
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         treatment == "Infection") %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  inner_join(all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse",
                      treatment == "Infection") %>% 
               select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "pathogen")
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("organism"),
              values_from = c(mean_log2fc, p_adj),
              names_sep = "_") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)))

  
# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "All genes") %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Same DEGs
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = "DEGs"), 
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
    human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% btm_annotation_genes %>%                                                     filter(module_category == "immune") %>%                                                     pull(symbol)),
                             "Immune",
                             "Not-immune")) %>% 
    #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05 
         # & sign(mean_log2fc_human) == sign(mean_log2fc_mouse))
  ))
  
   

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, gene_type) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the correlation
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  function(x, y, method = "spearman") {
    cor.test(x, y, method = method)
  },
  otherwise = NULL
)

cor_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, gene_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test_spearman = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human, method = "spearman")),
    cor_test_pearson = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human, method = "pearson")),,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(degs_immune_nonimmune_summary, by = join_by("pathogen", "timepoint", "gene_type")) %>% 
  mutate(
    #Spearman
    cor_value_spearman = map_dbl(cor_test_spearman, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_spearman   = map_dbl(cor_test_spearman, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label_spearman = case_when(
      is.na(p_spearman)      ~ "ns",
      p_spearman <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_spearman <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_spearman <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label_spearman = paste0("rho=", round(cor_value_spearman, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label_spearman),
    #Pearson
    cor_value_pearson = map_dbl(cor_test_pearson, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_pearson   = map_dbl(cor_test_pearson, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label_pearson = case_when(
      is.na(p_pearson)      ~ "ns",
      p_pearson <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_pearson <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_pearson <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label_pearson = paste0("r=", round(cor_value_pearson, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label_pearson)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value_spearman,
          cor_value_pearson) %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)),
    gene_type = factor(gene_type, levels = c("All genes", "DEGs", "Not-immune", "Immune")),
    facet_label = paste0(gene_type, ": ", label_spearman))

cor_data_facetted = cor_data %>% 
  arrange(gene_type) %>% 
   group_by(pathogen, timepoint, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    facet_label = paste(facet_label, collapse = "\n"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>% 
  mutate(facet_label = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", facet_label),
         facet_label = fct_reorder(facet_label, parse_number(timepoint %>% as.character())))
cor_data
cor_data_facetted


human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_labels = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  inner_join(cor_data_facetted, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "timepoint", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>% 
  distinct()
```

```{r}
log2fc_samples %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus")


#Get DEGs from different organisms
mouse_degs = all_degs_human_mouse %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05, organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(pathogen, human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  ungroup()
human_degs = all_degs_human_mouse %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05, organism == "Human") %>%
  select(pathogen, human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Get shared DEGs by filtering from both organisms
human_mouse = bind_rows(
  
  #Vaccination (day x to day x)
  mouse_degs %>%
  inner_join(human_degs %>%
               ungroup() %>%
               filter(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B")) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint", "pathogen")),
  #Infection (day x to day x)
  mouse_degs %>% 
  inner_join(human_degs %>%
               ungroup() %>%
               filter(!pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B")) %>%
               select(-timepoint) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "pathogen")),
  #Infection (day x to day y, z)
  human_degs %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = parse_number(timepoint)) %>% 
  distinct()
```

New, by pathogen, all vs all.
```{r}
compute_corr_by_pathogen = function(df) {

  genes_samples_wide =
    df %>% 
    select(human_symbol, condition, log2fc) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = condition,
      values_from = log2fc
    ) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  cor_mat = rcorr(as.matrix(genes_samples_wide), type = "spearman")

  tibble(
    condition1 = rep(colnames(cor_mat$r), each = ncol(cor_mat$r)),
    condition2 = rep(colnames(cor_mat$r), times = ncol(cor_mat$r)),
    correlation = as.vector(cor_mat$r),
    p_value     = as.vector(cor_mat$P),
    n_genes     = as.vector(cor_mat$n)
  )
}

correlation_long_by_pathogen =
  genes_samples_long %>% 
  group_by(pathogen) %>% 
  group_modify(~ compute_corr_by_pathogen(.x)) %>% 
  ungroup()


correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary =
  correlation_long_by_pathogen %>% 

  inner_join(
    samples_annotation %>% 
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
      rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
    by = "condition1"
  ) %>% 

  inner_join(
    samples_annotation %>% 
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
      rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
    by = "condition2"
  ) %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # (opcional mas seguro)
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_condition1,
         pathogen == pathogen_condition2) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(
    comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
    timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)
  ) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics
  group_by(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    timepoint_condition1,
    timepoint_condition2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 

  arrange(pathogen, comparison)  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2))

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary
```

```{r}
#Convert to wide
dge_btm_process_genes_wide =
  dge_btm_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = organism,
      values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    select(
      symbol,
      pathogen,
      process, 
      timepoint,
      Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      Human = mean_l2fc_Human,
      adj_p_val_Mouse,
      adj_p_val_Human,
      group
    ) %>% 
  drop_na(Human, Mouse) 

safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_btm_process_genes_correlation = dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%
  # substituir NULL por lista com NA
  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))

filter_1 = dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
gsea_btm_results_core = gsea_btm_results_all_matched %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/")

gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status)


shared_perc = gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process, status) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100,
         percent = percent %>% round(0)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Which are the processes that share most of the core genes?
shared_perc %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared") %>% 
  arrange(-n, -percent)

#What is the mean percentage?
mean_percentage_shared = shared_perc %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, status) %>% 
  summarise(mean_perc = mean(percent)) %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared")

mean_percentage_shared

  filter(status == "Shared") %>% 
  inner_join(mean_percentage_shared %>% 
               filter(status == "Shared"), by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint, status)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),

         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>% 
  mutate(process = fct_reorder(process, percent),
         facet_label = paste0(timepoint, ",\n Mean Shared = ", round(mean_perc, 1), "%")) %>% 
  arrange(-n, -percent)
```

Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?

```{r}
#Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?
df_test =
  dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(str_detect(process, "S2")) %>% 
  
  # Join com os genes core
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "S2")),
    by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", symbol == gene)
  ) %>% 
  
  # join com shared %
  inner_join(
    shared_perc %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "S2"),
             status == "Shared") %>%
      rename(percent = percent,
             status_percent = status),
    by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")
  ) %>%
  
  # join com NES
  inner_join(
    dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "S2")) %>% 
      select(process, pathogen, timepoint, nes_Mouse, nes_Human),
    by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")
  ) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    nes_Mouse = round(nes_Mouse, 2),
    nes_Human = round(nes_Human, 2)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not core", status)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Saureus", "Ecoli")) %>% 
  inner_join(dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
               select(timepoint, pathogen, process, cor_value, r_squared, p_label, cor_label),
             by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(# criar label completo para facet
    facet_label = paste0(timepoint, ",\nShared = ", percent, "%,\n",
      "NES Mouse = ", nes_Mouse, ",\nNES Human = ", nes_Human
    ))
```

##### Module-level, BTMs

Plot correlation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Mouse vs Human
#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_btm_results_all_matched %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse)


dge_btm_process_genes_wide = dge_btm_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))


```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) 


# NES vs NES
cor_labels_nes <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(nes_Human) %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, pathogen, group, Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label))
```

#### Hallmarks

Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "all_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Duplicate human
dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val) %>% 
  bind_rows(
  #Duplcate Human
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         treatment == "Infection") %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val) %>% 
  inner_join(all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse",
                      treatment == "Infection") %>% 
               select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "pathogen")
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)))
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
gsea_hallmarks_results_fluad = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("influenza_fluad_human_mouse_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
gsea_hallmarks_results_engerix = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))

gsea_hallmarks_results_all = bind_rows(
  gsea_hallmarks_results_saureus,
  gsea_hallmarks_results_ecoli,
  gsea_hallmarks_results_fluad %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  gsea_hallmarks_results_engerix %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint))
) %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% select(-symbol) %>% distinct(), by = join_by(process))

#Unite hallmarks means
dge_hallmarks_mean_process_saureus = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_mean_process_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_mean_process_fluad = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_mean_process_engerix  = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_mean_process_all = bind_rows(
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process_saureus,
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process_ecoli,
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process_fluad %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process_engerix %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint))
)

#Unite DGE results annotated with hallmarkss
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_saureus = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_fluad = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_engerix = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_all = bind_rows(
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_saureus,
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_ecoli,
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_fluad %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_engerix %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint))
)

#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_hallmarks_results_all %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(condition, "Human") ~ "Human",
                              T~condition)) %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, group, set_size, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, qvalue) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, process, group, set_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, qvalue, set_size),
    names_sep = "_")
```

##### Module-level, BTMs

Import

```{r}
#Import results -------

filename = "all_human_mouse"

#Duplicate reference, if timepoints do not match =================
gsea_hallmarks_results_all_matched = gsea_hallmarks_results_all %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, process, group, timepoint, nes, p_adjust, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  bind_rows(
  #Duplcate Human
  gsea_hallmarks_results_all %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         pathogen %in% c("Saureus", "Ecoli")) %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, process, group, nes, p_adjust, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(gsea_hallmarks_results_all %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse",
                      pathogen %in% c("Saureus", "Ecoli")) %>% 
               select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "pathogen")
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

```

Plot correlation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Mouse vs Human
#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_hallmarks_results_all_matched %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust),
    names_sep = "_") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse)


```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group, Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) 


# NES vs NES
cor_labels_nes <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(nes_Human) %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, pathogen, group, Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label))



```







###### Plot means

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint))

#Plot correlation plot (means)
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot =  dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint, "\n", cor_label),
         facet_name = fct_reorder(facet_name, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_log2fc_Human,
      labels = process) +
  facet_nested_wrap(vars(pathogen, facet_name),
                    scales = "free",
                    nrow = 3,
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
    #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  
#Plot all points
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 color = group),
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.2,
             pch = 21) +
  #Plot only significant in both
  geom_point(aes(fill = group),
             data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25),
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 1,
             pch = 21) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  guides(color = F) +
  labs(fill = "Group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)",
       title = paste0("MSigDB Hallmarks, GSEA, Log2FC mean, ", filename),
       subtitle = "Processes that have padj <0.25 in both human and model have alpha = 1.") +
  # ylim(-2, 2) +
  # xlim(-1, 2) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
           ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
          )

dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot

#Save results
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot.png")),
         width = 10,
         height = 8)
```
